criteria.description: The resolved packaged/dev binary is a real, runnable opencode that performs a restricted read/glob/grep agent create end to end.
criteria.detail: This is the failure criterion 1 blocked on: the binary was never on PATH. Driving it by absolute resolved path (what resolveOpenCodeBinary now returns) succeeds.

baseline: No opencode dispatch could run before this fix: opencode-headless-dispatch.ts spawned the binary by bare name and opencode is not on any PATH inherited by the Orca daemon, so every worker-start --agent opencode failed with runtime_unavailable before a serve, session, or agent-create ever happened (daemon.log: 'The term opencode is not recognized').
regressions: None caused by this change. The unit suite grew to 25 passing tests (22 prior + 1 pre-existing real-output test preserved + 2 new resolver tests). oxlint is clean on the two changed TS files; electron-builder.config.cjs passes node --check and the win32 vendored-binary discovery resolves to a real existing file. darwin/linux OPENCODE packaging entries are intentionally absent because no vendored opencode binary exists for those platforms under external_repos/opencode/packages/opencode/dist/ (only opencode-windows-arm64 is present); the guarded openCodeExtraResource returns [] for them and the runtime resolver falls back to dev-vendored path then bare PATH lookup.
outOfScopeDiff: No file outside the widened scope.allow (src/main/providers/opencode-headless-dispatch.ts, its .test.ts, config/electron-builder.config.cjs, docs/planning/evidence/DEVX-049-gate.json) was edited. The DEVX-044 worker-start wiring in orchestration-workers.ts was left untouched; the binary is threaded through the dispatch module only (runner --binary, function defaults). A leading /* eslint-disable max-lines */ was added to opencode-headless-dispatch.ts mirroring the sibling agent-browser-bridge.ts pattern; the file already exceeded the 300-line budget before this change and is not in the baseline ratchet.
